title: METAL
summary: Makes hits ring like metal, tuned to the key of your bass.
steps: Add METAL to percussion or accents.
A preset sets Note to the key of your bass by itself.
Decay is how long it rings; Crush makes it broken and digital.
Mix is how much metal you hear against the hit.

examples.title: Metal hits in key
examples.text: Every hit rings a short low note in your key.

examples.title: Glass bells
examples.text: High, clean bells on short hits.
